overview_description.description:
Lending Club is an online financial community that brings together creditworthy borrowers and savvy investors so that both can benefit financially. They replace the high cost and complexity of bank lending with a faster, smarter way to borrow and invest.

Founded in 2007, the company is headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

about_short_description.short_description: Happen is a digital bank that provides personal and business loans, investments, financing, and various banking services.

product.name: Personal Loans
product.description: Unsecured loans for debt repayment, large expenses, and other personal financing needs, with online rate checking and loan amounts from $1,000 to $75,000.

product.name: Personal Banking
product.description: Digital banking services for personal checking and savings, including direct deposit, debit card access, cash-back programs, early payday access, and mobile account management.

product.name: LevelUp Savings
product.description: A personal savings account designed to earn variable interest on deposited funds, with no minimum opening deposit and a higher rate available when qualifying deposits are made.

product.name: Auto Refinancing
product.description: Auto refinancing loans that replace an existing vehicle loan, potentially changing the borrower’s interest rate, payment amount, or remaining repayment terms.

product.name: Business Loans
product.description: Business financing for companies seeking capital for operating needs, expansion, equipment, or other business expenses, subject to eligibility and credit approval.

product.name: Financing Solutions
product.description: Financing services offered through Happen’s provider network for customers or businesses seeking credit to support purchases or other funding requirements.
